name: Lithium carbonate
aliases: carbonic acid, dilithium salt, dilithium carbonate, Li2CO3
summary: Lithium carbonate is an inorganic compound, the lithium salt of carbonic acid with the formula Li2CO3.

pharmacology.text: Its alkaline properties are conducive to changing the state of metal oxide colorants in glaze, particularly red iron oxide (Fe2O3).

uses.text: In 1843, lithium carbonate was used to treat bladder and kidney stones. In 1859, some doctors recommended the compound for a number of ailments, including gout, urinary calculi, rheumatism, mania, depression, and headache.

summaryZh: 碳酸鋰（英語：lithium carbonate）是一種重要的無機化合物，具體來說，它是種碳酸的鋰鹽，化學式為 Li2CO3。這種鹽外觀為白色晶體，在多個工業領域和醫療應用中扮演著關鍵角色。
summaryZhHans: 碳酸锂（英语：lithium carbonate）是一种重要的无机化合物，具体来说，它是种碳酸的锂盐，化学式为 Li2CO3。这种盐外观为白色晶体，在多个工业领域和医疗应用中扮演着关键角色。
